summary: Focused re-test of Marketplace 'Shop by Category' tile image CSS fix (iteration_17 previously failed at ~20px). Fix VERIFIED: .cat-tile now display:flex column width:100% and .ct-img fills the tile width. Measured all 4 tiles at 1440x900 as logged-in owner.

issues: ct-img rendered height is 125px, but CSS declares height:150px. Likely because .cat-tile has fixed height 168px (line 2195 in App.css) and label+count below squeeze the image to 125px. Not a blocker (width fills correctly, images cover), but height is less than the 150px specified in the request. Consider removing the fixed 168px .cat-tile height or increasing it to ~200px so ct-img can be full 150px.

cat-tile-jobs.note: No inner ; renders text placeholder 'Jobs' inside .ct-img (intentional per code)

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: The rendered .ct-img height is 125px (not 150px). The fixed .cat-tile height:168px (App.css line 2195) constrains the image. If the exact 150px height is required, either remove line 2195 or raise it to ~200px so image can reach 150px + label + count below.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css has duplicate .cat-tile blocks (lines 537, 1122, 2195, 2369). Consolidate to a single canonical block to avoid future width/height regressions.
cat-tile-jobs falls back to a text placeholder 'Jobs' instead of an image; consider adding a real image or a nicer icon for visual parity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for core bug fix; minor height discrepancy noted

context_for_next_testing_agent: Category-tile CSS bug (~20px narrow strip) is fully resolved. Tiles are 156px wide and .ct-img fills the tile width. Only cosmetic remaining item is ct-img height (125px vs 150px spec) caused by fixed .cat-tile height:168px in App.css line 2195. Featured Stories rail + ListingCards render fine, no horizontal overflow at 1440x900.
rca of the issue: Previous root cause: .cat-tile was a shrink-wrapping <button> so width:100% on .ct-img resolved to content width (~20px). Fix in App.css line 2369 sets .cat-tile { display:flex; flex-direction:column; width:100%; padding:0 } making it fill its grid column, so .ct-img width:100% now resolves to ~156px within the 4-column grid at 1440px viewport. Confirmed by bounding-box measurements.
